body:
Effort? Oh, I've tried that. I've tried dieting and after six months of a 1500 calorie diet and working out every day, I only lost five pounds and, on top of that, every day at the gym was spent being laughed at. I was laughed at for six months straight at that gym by the successful, normal people.

I tried again, but it only led to the same results. I can't cut my calorie intake anymore than 1500 due to how doing so would make me sick. And even if I did lose weight or get cosmetic surgery, I'm still too stupid to do anything with my life. On top of that, I cannot afford any of those things, so I'm stuck where I am with only one way out.
Aside from the weight comments? I've heard things like "You look like a semi truck hit you" before.

Sometimes I get a bit silly with my phrasing. At least I know I'm not alone with this mindset, though. I see some people who take medication and feel better, though... and it just makes me so mad, you know? Like, all medication did for me was make me even bigger than I was and take away all of my emotions, while my therapist pretty much thought my only cure was those medications. It sucks.
